RELOCATION PROGRAM PLAN
The purpose of this plan is to correlate and update the originally submitted plans for the two proposed projects known as the Airport Spur along with a proposed INTERIM POLICY STATEMENT.
There are no additional families to be displaced on these proposed projects; in fact, there are two less than indicated in the original plans. Between the two projects, there were thirteen (13) families and now there are eleven (11). One parcel, indicated as unit one (1) in the plan filed for Project U 078-1(1), was acquired as an advance purchase as a hardship. The other parcel, indicated as unit twelve (12) in the plan filed for Project U 078-1(1), has been removed due to a design change.
The parcel that was acquired as an advance purchase was done so at the request of the former owner. They have moved to Hayward, Wisconsin. We are in contact with their attorney who is in the process of preparing their relocation benefit claim.
We have surveyed an area bounded by Oklahoma Avenue on the north, Ryan Road on the south, Lake Michigan on the east and South 27th Street on the west to determine what is available in both rental and purchase units on the open market. We have used the same sources as used in the original plans. The survey area used in this combined plan is smaller than that used in the original plans.
